name: Polar Bear
intro: A polar bear is a big white bear. It lives where it is very cold.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A polar bear is a very big bear.
It is the biggest bear in the world.
Its fur looks white.
Its skin under the fur is black.
Thick fat keeps it warm.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Polar bears live in the Arctic.
The Arctic is very cold and icy.
They spend lots of time on sea ice.
In summer, the ice melts and they walk on land.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Polar bears eat mostly seals.
They wait by holes in the ice.
Seals come up to the holes to breathe.
Polar bears can smell a seal from far away.
Sometimes they eat berries or seaweed.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: Baby polar bears are called cubs.
Cubs are born in a snow den in winter.
A new cub is as small as a stick of butter.
In spring, the cubs go outside with mom.
Mom teaches them how to hunt.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Polar bears are great swimmers.
Their big front paws help them paddle.
They clean their fur by rolling in snow.
Each hair is clear, not really white.
Polar bears do not hibernate all winter.
